scope: Target-owned photo/PDF product path as governed image engineering: synthetic 12-lead paper generation, ROI localization, standard-layout ROI discovery with digitization-qualified 90-degree orientation search, grid calibration, bounded sparse-column digitization, strict-subset stdlib PNG decode, mandatory bound preflight for every external image input, measurement gating, atomic content-addressed case persistence with verified source/raster artifacts, append-only immutable digitized extraction generations, canonical per-lead measurement/rhythm/phenotype analysis, and immutable analysis generations bound to exact extractions and preflight permissions. registryNote: ECG-CAP-IMAGE-ROI-LOCALIZATION, ECG-CAP-IMAGE-GRID-CALIBRATION, and ECG-CAP-IMAGE-DIGITIZATION remain RESEARCH_REFERENCE in the frozen realization checkpoint so historical readiness counts stay exact. Executable code exists independently of that promotion.

proofBoundary.pngSupportedSubset: 8-bit non-interlaced grayscale, RGB, and RGBA; RGBA is composited over white; tRNS and unsupported critical chunks fail closed
